rules.assertion: cancelling a patient admission deletes the associated takip state; the sandbox must not leave orphan takip records behind.

sourceRefs.notes: Encodes the cancellation state effect; sandbox contract, not official behavior.

rules.assertion: fatura-iptal requires an existing invoice record for the referenced faturaTeslimNo; cancelling a missing invoice must return a non-success code and leave state unchanged.

sourceRefs.notes: Encodes the cancellation state effect; sandbox contract, not official behavior.

rules.assertion: tanilar is optional per service-registration call, but every takip must end up with at least one diagnosis (s.189).
takipNo is required when takipTipi is B; a bagli takip must reference the existing tracking number it is attached to.

sourceRefs.notes: Condition follows the documented bagli-takip pattern; verify before review.

rules.condition: the invoice covers services related to a traffic accident
rules.assertion: trafikKazasiOdemeYuzdesi is required when the invoiced episode is traffic-accident related.

sourceRefs.notes: Condition follows the documented traffic-accident rule; verify before review.

rules.condition: an invoice already exists for the same patient application flow
rules.assertion: a second invoice for the same flow must return a non-success result and must not create duplicate invoice state (PRD 15.5).

sourceRefs.notes: Encodes the duplicate-invoice scenario contract; sandbox behavior, not official behavior.

rules.assertion: faturaTarihi must not be in the future.

sourceRefs.notes: Common invoice constraint; verify against the guide before review.

rules.assertion: saglikTesisKodu, hastaTCKimlikNo, provizyonTipi, tedaviTuru, takipTipi and bransKodu are mandatory for hasta-kabul; the sandbox must reject a request missing any of them with a validation error.
saglikTesisKodu, takipNo and ktsHbysKodu are mandatory for hizmet-kayit; hastaBasvuruNo is optional per Tablo 4.2.1.a (s.189).
saglikTesisKodu, faturaTarihi, hastaBasvuruNo, faturaRefNo and hizmetDetaylari are mandatory for fatura-kayit.
hizmet-kayit requires an existing tracking record in an active state; registering services against a missing or cancelled takip must return a non-success code and leave state unchanged (PRD 15.2).

fatura-kayit requires at least one registered service record for the patient application flow; invoicing without services must return a sandbox-specific non-success code and must not create invoice state (PRD 15.4).
a successful hasta-kabul creates a patientAdmission state and at least one takip state, and generates hastaBasvuruNo plus takipNo identifiers (PRD 14 workflow step 1).

sourceRefs.notes: Encodes the core-claim-flow step effects; sandbox contract, not official behavior.
